name: livetennisapi/livetennisapi
description: Official PHP client for the Live Tennis API — real-time tennis scores, players, fixtures, head-to-heads, a 1968-onward results archive, point-by-point tapes, rally and charting data, rankings, match-winner market prices and model win-probability for ATP, WTA, Challenger, ITF and juniors.

suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: A PSR-18 HTTP client and PSR-17 factories the library will auto-discover
suggest.symfony/http-client: An alternative PSR-18 HTTP client the library will auto-discover
